seasonal_archetype_evidence: One best overall period (September: harvest usually under way, green vines, warm not hot) with real alternatives: early October as the close second with the Sagra dell'Uva, May for spring vineyards and the open-cellar weekend, June to August for long dry days with heat, November to February for quieter cellar-and-lunch days.
season_proof_evidence: Not season-proof: the harvest, the state of the vines, the summer heat (31-32°C average highs at Ciampino in July-August) and the autumn rain change the outdoor half of the tour; the featured tour runs half as many days in January-February.
availability_sentence: Frascati wine tours are available year-round, although winter brings fewer departures, most wineries work by appointment and some estates close for a few days around Ferragosto, the 15 August holiday.

factor_weights.factor: what the vines are doing and whether the harvest is under way
factor_weights.why: The vineyard is the setting of the farmhouse visit; harvest usually September into early October (ARSIAL 2017: first ten days of September in an early year; later Malvasia picking into October); bare vines November to March.
Ciampino average highs 31.0°C in July and 31.6°C in August against 26.7°C in September and 23.3°C in May (WMO 1991-2020); the town walk and vineyard visit are outdoors around midday.

Ciampino rainy days (>=1 mm): 6.0 in September, 7.3 October, 8.8 November, 9.4 December, 5.5 May; rainfall 88-108 mm October-December. Rain affects the walk and the vineyard, not the tasting and lunch.
Sagra dell'Uva in Marino around the first Sunday of October (2026: 26-27 September and 3-5 October); Cantine Aperte at the end of May (2026: 30-31 May).
Featured tour runs four days a week April-October and two in January-February; no dates 9-23 August 2027; public holidays.
Eurostat Lazio nights 2024: July 5.69 million (peak), September 86%, October 87%, May and June 90%, January 46%, February 56%, December 55% of July. Proxy only.

visit_profile.typical_visit: A half-day of about four hours meeting outside Frascati station: guided town walk with a wine-and-snack stop, transfer to a family wine farmhouse, vineyard and old-cellar visit, three-wine tasting and a chef's lunch (featured 410821). Alternatives: farmhouse pasta masterclass (601703) or a three-hour tasting with a private driver from Rome (848244).
